verdict.rationale: The GitHub README says users can add MCP servers from the Library in Settings and that every model sees the same tools. This directly covers plugging in MCP servers so the agent can use their tools. Per-session and full-permissions controls govern those tool calls. missing for 10: details on whether arbitrary or custom MCP servers can be added beyond the Library, supported transports (stdio/HTTP), configuration or auth documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
